trusted_base_required_check_deferred.reason: The trusted-base workflow uses pull_request_target and the prior policy expressly requires the trusted-base workflow to be present on the repository default branch before activation. That prerequisite is not silently inherited by the preservation branch.

minimum_approval_count_deferred.reason: The currently declared CODEOWNER topology names the repository owner. Requiring one approving review plus CODEOWNER approval on self-authored changes could create a mechanical deadlock without first establishing an eligible reviewer topology. Review standing remains separately preserved and does not arise from this interim mechanical profile.

codeowner_review_requirement_deferred.reason: CODEOWNER enforcement is deferred until a separately governed reviewer topology can satisfy it without converting repository mechanics into implied independence or authority.

activation_preconditions_for_interim_pro: A repository administrator verifies the exact required-status-check contexts exposed by GitHub before applying settings.
The target branch still equals the governed preservation lineage at application time.
No newer governed enforcement disposition supersedes this record.
Application is preserved as a separate attributable repository-settings act.
non_claims: This disposition does not itself change GitHub repository settings or branch protection.
This disposition does not authorize a default-branch transition or rewrite the prior future-default-branch policy.

The interim profile does not establish reviewer independence, substantive correctness, empirical validation, model standing, production readiness, compliance, endorsement, or institutional acceptance.
Required status checks are mechanical gates only and do not transfer evidentiary or governance authority.
Deferring approval and CODEOWNER requirements in the interim profile is a deadlock-avoidance measure, not a claim that review is unnecessary.
A later repository-settings application must verify actual GitHub check contexts and preserve any mismatch rather than silently substituting names.
